
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yeyunfei/p/23646034/threejs-3d-fire-drill-evacuation-02" title="发布于 2026-11-14 09:59">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何使用 three.js 实现 3D 消防疏散，走廊封了怎么改道——第二课｜WebGL</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        three.js、WebGL 3D 消防演练第二课：走廊节点与通道关系、Dijkstra 改道、封闭区域排除、三维路线清理及状态版本更新。配五张空间设计图。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<blockquote>
<h2>序</h2>
<p>手机里的群越来越多，真正需要看的消息倒不一定多。一个通知转发三遍，再跟上几十个“收到”，原消息就找不到了。大家都很积极，手机也很忙，只有事情本身还在原地。</p>
<p>有时候觉得，静音功能实在是个好发明。当然，该看的通知还是得看，不然第二天就要解释为什么没收到。</p>
<p>上篇把烟感和房间对应起来了。这篇继续往下做：二楼东侧走廊在演练中封闭，原来画好的路线要撤掉，再看能不能从另一侧楼梯出去。</p>
<h2>一、先把能走的地方连起来</h2>
<p><img alt="系统界面：空间总览：通道改道" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202611/800616-20261114083814189-130426586.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>路线沿门口、转角和楼梯口连接，别从办公桌中间穿过去。配图坐标属于本次教学案例；实际通行关系应来自核对过的平面资料和预案。</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">const nodes = new Map([
  ['room', [2, 6, -3]], ['hall', [2, 6, 0]],
  ['east', [7, 6, 0]], ['west', [-5, 6, 0]],
  ['exitE', [7, 6, 4]], ['exitW', [-5, 6, 4]]
]);
const links = [
  ['door', 'room', 'hall'], ['eastHall', 'hall', 'east'],
  ['westHall', 'hall', 'west'], ['eastStair', 'east', 'exitE'],
  ['westStair', 'west', 'exitW']
].map(([id, a, b]) =&gt; ({
  id, a, b,
  cost: new THREE.Vector3(...nodes.get(a))
    .distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3(...nodes.get(b)))
}));
const exits = new Set(['exitE', 'exitW']);
</code></pre>
<p>节点少的时候，这张表就能把位置关系交代清楚。路径 ID 单独保存，后面封闭的是哪一段，也就不用从一串坐标里猜。</p>
<h2>二、东侧封闭以后，重新计算</h2>
<p><img alt="系统界面：对象定位：通道改道" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202611/800616-20261114083819364-1656146671.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>这次用 Dijkstra 查找可到达的预案出口。封闭边不参与计算；两个出口都不可达，就返回空值，不能继续亮着上一条路线。</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">function findExit(start, closed) {
  if (!nodes.has(start)) return null;
  const dist = new Map([[start, 0]]);
  const previous = new Map();
  const pending = new Set([start]);
  while (pending.size) {
    const current = [...pending].reduce((a, b) =&gt;
      dist.get(a) &lt; dist.get(b) ? a : b);
    pending.delete(current);
    if (exits.has(current)) {
      const path = [current];
      while (previous.has(path[0])) path.unshift(previous.get(path[0]));
      return path;
    }
    for (const edge of links) {
      if (closed.has(edge.id)) continue;
      const next = edge.a === current ? edge.b
        : edge.b === current ? edge.a : null;
      if (!next) continue;
      const candidate = dist.get(current) + edge.cost;
      if (candidate &gt;= (dist.get(next) ?? Infinity)) continue;
      dist.set(next, candidate);
      previous.set(next, current);
      pending.add(next);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const closed = new Set(['eastHall']);
const path = findExit('room', closed);
</code></pre>
<p>小场景这样写够用了。节点上万时再换优先队列，并把路径计算移到 Worker，别让计算和鼠标拖动抢主线程。</p>
<h2>三、把计算结果放回三维</h2>
<p><img alt="系统界面：拐角入口：两侧门体与门框对象" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202611/800616-20261114083824273-1270073673.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>画线时直接使用返回的节点序列。转角保持折线，不做穿墙的圆滑插值；整条路线稍微抬高一点，避免和地面闪烁。</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">let routeLine = null;

function drawRoute(path) {
  if (routeLine) {
    routeLine.removeFromParent();
    routeLine.geometry.dispose();
    routeLine.material.dispose();
    routeLine = null;
  }
  if (!path) return;
  const points = path.map(id =&gt; {
    const point = new THREE.Vector3(...nodes.get(id));
    point.y += 0.08;
    return point;
  });
  routeLine = new THREE.Line(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x64b08c })
  );
  scene.add(routeLine);
}

drawRoute(path);
</code></pre>
<p>图里的楼梯和房门是参照物。界面除了显示路线，还应保留当前所在楼层、目的出口和本次通道状态的版本。</p>
<h2>四、通道状态变了，再走一遍</h2>
<p><img alt="系统界面：出口门与通行空间" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202611/800616-20261114083829400-705621212.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>服务端推来的状态按版本更新。下面每次先撤旧线，再计算新线，避免出现新告警到了、旧路线还在的情况。<code>notice</code> 对应页面中用于显示提示的一块文字区域。</p>
<pre><code class="language-js">let routeVersion = -1;

function onPassageState(message, notice) {
  if (message.mode !== 'drill') return;
  if (!Number.isInteger(message.version)) return;
  if (message.version &lt;= routeVersion) return;
  if (!Array.isArray(message.closedIds)) return;
  routeVersion = message.version;
  drawRoute(null);
  const blocked = new Set(message.closedIds);
  const nextPath = findExit(message.personNode, blocked);
  drawRoute(nextPath);
  notice.textContent = nextPath
    ? `演练路线 V${routeVersion} → ${nextPath.at(-1)}`
    : '当前无可用演练路线，等待人工确认';
  return nextPath;
}
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="系统界面：楼梯与楼层连接" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/800616/202611/800616-20261114083834541-1393414880.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>最后试三种情况就很直观：只封东侧、只封西侧、两侧都封。路线应当分别改道、改道、清空。到这里，三维里画的线才跟演练状态连上了。</p>
<p>下一篇把报警、封闭和改道按时间记下来，做一个能暂停、能回退的演练复盘。</p>
